description: Choose whether visitors' writes reach the site: signing up, posting, commenting, saving, liking. 'block' (the default) sends nothing to the site; 'send' lets those through for real. Only the user can decide this — ask them, and only call this with their answer. 'send' suits a test or staging site, or data that may be messed up; on a live site real users will see what visitors post. Payments, deleting, wallet connections and sign-out stay blocked either way. Saved in .usercase/settings.json.

mode.description: block = nothing is sent to the site; send = writes really reach the site

name: set_writes
